title: Darth Maul
description: Sith apprentice Darth Maul first clashed with Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn on Tatooine as Queen Amidala's startship was attempting to depart. During the Battle of Naboo, Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan Kenobi engaged Maul in a duel. Maul defeated Qui-Gon, running him through. Obi-Wan and Maul renewed their clash, and Obi-Wan bisected the Sith.
